verdicts.summary: Combined rev-parse keeps old semantics; the fallback and line-count guard hold in the cases I tried.
verdicts.scenario: Tried unborn HEAD, not-a-repo (128), git<2.31 echoing --path-format, a newline in the common-dir path, and the changed operation label. Unborn HEAD with --quiet --verify gives exit 1 and no output, so 3 lines is correct, and the old `--verify HEAD` also yielded false. A newline in the common dir shows up in both the common-dir and index paths, so the line count is at least 5 and never matches 3 or 4. Old git adds an echoed line, so the count mismatches and the fallback runs. Exit 128 skips the guard and the fallback reports the old resolveGitCommonDir label. The old hasHeadCommit also ran without a custom env, so env is unchanged. The darwin fsync retry is skipped only because allowNonZeroExit is set, and no fsync args are present in this call.
